author: Krono I
title: Paper Recovery 2: Bottleneck Blocks on Standard-Width CNN
abstract: This is the second of five experiments required to correct my rejected paper. It tests the generality of my Bottleneck block innovation by applying it to a standard-width (32/64) CNN backbone, not just the SOTA wide version. This directly addresses the reviewer's suggestion to demonstrate generality.
